title: Edwin NDE 10
content: It was accidental. While changing a light bulb in the toilet, I was later informed that I had suffered a severe electric shock of two hundred and forty volts. I was informed that due to the electrocution; I had fallen of the ladder, and had hit my head on the toilet bowl. I believe I actually left my body in the toilet. However, I did follow it to the hospital and watched in awe, as my body lay limp, while ambulance officers and doctors attempted to revive me. I was aware of other 'spirits' around me. Some were grey in color, while others were transparent like myself. After ten minutes, I was pronounced dead by the doctors, it was however thirty minutes later, according to the records that I 'recovered'.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes I was electrocuted and suffered severe concussion, which actually cracked my skull open.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was transparent, but I knew I was there, because I was able to feel things and was aware of my surroundings because of this. However, it became quite apparent that whatever I was touching could not feel me.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I was not aware of any noises.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I didn't communicate to them, I was merely aware of their presence.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt at ease, and was never aware of time. I felt that I was not obliged to do anything, as I was in oneness with myself. I was not at all confined by worldly constraints - such as inability to fly or pass through immovable, stationary objects.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I did not learn anything, I simply believe I was in a state of limbo or transition.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: me back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control I did not learn anything, I simply believe I was in a state of limbo or transition. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I became a homosexual. After the NDE
